title: My Competitive Shoot 'em Up is Live! (Ranked Ladder, Unique Synergy Buffs, Cloud Saves
author: Significant-Tap9123
selftext:
Hey everyone! 🚀

After months of hard work, I’m incredibly excited to share my latest project with you: a **fast-paced, modern Shoot 'em Up (Shmup) built for high-octane competition**.

If you love dodging bullet hell patterns while optimizing your build to absolutely crush high scores, this is your next addiction.

Here is what’s waiting for you in the cockpit:

* **Ranked Leaderboards:** A fully integrated online ranking system to prove your skill. Climb the competitive ladder and claim your spot as the ultimate pilot.
* **Game-Changing Buff Effects:** Forget generic power-ups. Every bonus you pick up offers unique synergies that alter your gameplay in real time. Find the perfect build to melt down screens.
* **Multiple Game Modes:** Whether you’re looking for a quick 5-minute adrenaline rush or a hardcore endurance challenge, our different modes will put your reflexes to the test.
* **Secure Cloud Account Saves:** Never lose your progress. Your stats, unlocked cosmetics, and competitive rank are safely backed up online.

I designed this game from the ground up to feature ultra-fluid controls and challenging, readable boss patterns.

👉 **Play it here:** [NEON INVADERS 2 — Play Free Online | AIGameShare](https://www.aigameshare.com/games/neon-invaders-2?play=1&mode=fullscreen)

As a solo developer, your feedback means everything to me. Check it out, let me know what you think about the buff balancing, and feel free to flex your first high scores in the comments below!

Good luck out there, see you on the leaderboard! 🌌

comments.author: Kalaminator
comments.body: The player moves and shoots too fast, I didn't play but unless the enemies get faster, that gives you an advantage that makes enemies boring. Hitting enemies should have some kind of indicators of how many times you hit then, like them changing colors or anything you can think of.  Enemies look slow, dumb and don't seem to represent a thread making power ups pointless. It looks like a worst versions of classic Galaga style arcades. Even in old Galaga I remember some of the guys flying around you.
